name: TomClabault/HIPRT-Path-Tracer
description: Unbiased physically-based GPU interactive path tracing renderer using AMD HIPRT, supporting RDNA2+ hardware ray tracing accelerators and NVIDIA devices via HIP compatibility.
score_rationale: Solid AMD-focused GPU path tracer with hardware RT support, filling an important niche not covered by NVIDIA-focused tools.
summary: AMD HIPRT-based GPU path tracer supporting RDNA2+ and NVIDIA hardware
